**Answer:**

No, that sentence is not true. It is actually the opposite! People usually use money to buy things that take time, like food or toys.

Imagine a hardworking **farmer**. The farmer spends many hours in the field planting seeds and watering plants. The farmer does not use time to buy money. Instead, the farmer uses their time and hard work to grow crops. Then, the farmer sells those crops to get money. So, we trade our time and effort to earn money, not the other way around!
